cache_payload_hash_policy: Original importer streams and validates all64 feature payload SHA on actual read; this audit does not duplicate feature hashing.

historical_reproduction.numerical_caveat: Downloaded historical infer.py defaults to CPU FP32; original saved features used the recorded original extraction pipeline. Same CP/point/data does not imply bit-identical independently extracted FP32 features. Measure any reproduction difference without changing protocol.

importer_limitations: It checks feature NPZ SHA and per-record metadata, but not physical checkpoint files or completed/init receipts; this audit supplies those checks.
It does not compare protocol_sha256 to the frozen source protocol; this audit verifies every required record against it.
It does not persist fitted coefficients/selected source-dev scores or transformed cache hashes itself; a wrapper may add provenance without changing predictions.
